items.title: Prediction markets exit three states as regulators tighten grip; Coinbase halts Michigan sports contracts
items.content_text: - **Prediction markets exit three states as regulators tighten grip; Coinbase halts Michigan sports contracts** — Prediction markets are retreating from three more U.S. states as regulators intensify pressure on sports event contracts, with Coinbase agreeing this week to halt new sports event contracts in Michigan according to Legal Sports Report. items.content_text: - **Brazil's central bank bans prediction markets, third Latin American crackdown** — Banco Central do Brasil and the National Monetary Council published Resolution No. 5,298 prohibiting derivative contracts tied to sports, politics, gaming and cultural or social outcomes, citing investor protection and market integrity. items.title: NFL files Supreme Court brief arguing prediction markets are gambling

items.title: CFTC moves to define prediction-market event contracts as swaps, excludes casino-style gambling

The report expects institutional use to grow around economics, business and political contracts, and sees sports' share of turnover falling from over 60% today to roughly half by 2030.
